svg.desc: Task detail: timeline-multi-turn with the previous turn expanded; timeline-pending with an inline request dock; task-states task 3 for failure. Fixed fixture clock 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, zh-CN UI. Tool disclosure controls share compact rows while retaining separate focus targets. Plan labels join their single step. Pending request history is represented by the dock while unanswered, then returns to the timeline when resolved. The dock heading owns passive routing. Failure evidence appears once in the outcome; the failed command disclosure moves to that outcome header. Process summaries omit facts already present in the task or turn header. Action rows use button/pending in place while submitting and disable siblings.
